question: The 2010 Commonwealth Games were held in _________ in India.
solution:
The correct answer is** __New Delhi.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• New Delhi hosted the **XIX** Commonwealth Games from 3rd to 14th October 2010.
 
• **Sheila Dikshit** was the Chief Minister of New Delhi in 2010.
 
• New Delhi has the **highest Population density** among UTs with **11,297 per square kilometer **as per the 2011 census.
 
• New Delhi is situated on the **west bank of the Yamuna** River.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Australia **topped** the medal tally with 177 medals including 74 Gold medals.
 
• India ranked** second** with 38 gold medals and 101 total medals
 
• The Mascot was** "Shera"**, an anthropomorphized tiger.
 
• The motto was "**Come out and play"**.
 
• The official song was **"Jiyo Utho Bado Jeeto".**
 
• Chandigarh is the **common capital** of the states of Punjab and Haryana.
 
• Mumbai is known as the **Financial Capital **of India.
 
• Lucknow is known as the **"City of Nawab"s, "Shiraz-i-Hind", and "The Golden City of the East".**
